## Data and Cost Impacts

State none or specify source/version/rights and attribution changes, Unicode,
references/versification, token order, lexical lemma/POS/morphology/Strong's
linkage, unresolved mappings, and interpretive uncertainty. Use the
[data contracts](https://github.com/jadamkraft/Tomlinson/blob/main/docs/DATA_SOURCES.md). Identify explicit approval and separate
diff review for any corpus regeneration; do not hide data repairs in unrelated work.

State none or describe dependency, download/cache, storage/network, operating
cost, and free-access changes, separating measurements from estimates.

## Exact Verification

Follow [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/jadamkraft/Tomlinson/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); consult current `package.json`.
Record each actual command, result, and failure rather than only checked boxes.

| Check / command | Result and evidence | Unverified scope / risk |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Focused falsifiable check and authentic fixture | | |
| Applicable tests and independent typecheck | | |
| Production build | | |
| Local Playwright: preview URL, browser/viewports, screenshots, interactions | | |
| RTL/mobile, selection/navigation, loading/errors, missing lexical data | | |
| Warmed-service-worker offline and updates when relevant | | |

For UI changes, include screenshot/artifact paths and assertions. Record mocked
feedback/external side effects, warmed assets, CDN/font behavior, and actual
client limitations. Do not claim first-load offline, linguistic correctness, or
client discovery from a build or structural checks alone.

## Remaining Risks and Approval

List failed, blocked, unrun, or not-applicable checks with reasons; unresolved
source/provenance and scholarly questions; and any requested owner decisions.

- [ ] Scope preserves unrelated work and matches the approved study need.
- [ ] Source observations, glosses, interpretation, and uncertainty stay distinct.
- [ ] No runtime AI, billing, or deployment added; existing Pages pipeline unchanged.
- [ ] No unapproved corpus regeneration, new corpus, or external submissions.
- [ ] Exact verification and data/provenance/cost impacts are reported honestly.

Owner review/merge remains separate; this template does not authorize commits,
pushes, deployment, cloud-agent activation, or repository-setting changes.
